artReview.seriesAssessment: Muted cinematic historical realism, soft courtyard backgrounds and believable robe textures are consistent. Seven named characters have distinguishable face, apparent age, facial-hair, headwear and costume cues; the three separately generated period variants remain independent compositions.
artReview.sameNativeDifferentNameControl: P2 Pang Tong and P1 Xu Shu have byte-identical original references but distinct generated portraits and file bytes, as independently checked in mapping-review-v1.json.
artReview.headroomAssessment: Full visible headwear and hair were checked. No claim of a measured 15 or 25 percent empty top margin.
